info.title: Central DB API
info.description: Public read-only API for Central DB.

get.summary: List books with latest Arabic version
get.description:
Returns all books, each annotated with the `latest ArabicVersion` (with list of all `version_number`).

- Optionally filter using query parameters.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search in title/name

200.description: List of books in Central DB

get.summary: List Arabic Phrases of latest Arabic version
get.description:
Return all ArabicPhrase rows for that version (ordered by chapter.serial, groupId, groupOrder) 
- Optional filters (query params): 
-- ?chapter=<serial>  -> limit to one chapter serial

parameters.name: chapter
parameters.description: get chapter with chapter number

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: get arabic phrases for specific version

200.description: List Arabic Phrases of latest Arabic version

get.summary: List languages for a book across all versions
get.description:
Returns languages list for the latest ArabicVersion of this book, PLUS any languages 
that exist in any previous version but not in the latest (flagged with from_previous_version=true). 
Languages are never repeated.

200.description: Returns languages list for the latest ArabicVersion and all previous versions

get.summary: List Translations Phrases of language from latest Arabic versions
get.description:
Return all phrases for that TranslationVersion 
that take latest ArabicVersion for that book (max version_number). 
For that AV + language(iso_code), take the latest TranslationVersion (max order)

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: get translations for specific version

200.description: Returns languages list for the latest ArabicVersion and previous version

get.description:
Returns card translation logs.
Optional query params:
- `from=YYYY-MM-DD`
- `to=YYYY-MM-DD`
- `external_id=<card external id>`

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Filter logs created on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Filter logs created on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: external_id
parameters.description: Filter logs for a specific card external_id.

get.summary: Get one card translation by old_id + language
get.description:
Returns one card resolved by CardVersion.old_id in a flattened response shape.
Use query params like `?id=3854&language=en`.
Optional `version=` targets a specific card version.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Card old_id value (e.g. 3854).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language ISO code (e.g. en).

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Specific card version to use. If omitted, uses the latest version for each old_id.

get.summary: List translation sentences for a card + language
get.description:
Returns all translation sentences for the latest CardVersion of this card in the given language.
Falls back to any previous version if the latest has no translation for that language.
Each sentence includes field id and field name.
Optional ?version= to target a specific CardVersion.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: CardVersion version number (e.g. 1.0). If omitted, uses the latest version.

get.summary: List translation languages for a card version
get.description:
Returns all languages that have translations for a specific CardVersion.
Looks up the card by external_id and the version by version number.

get.summary: List version sentences by card external_id + version
get.description:
Returns CardSentence rows for a given (card external_id, version).
Example: /api/encyclopedias/cards/123/version/1.0/sentences/

get.summary: List translation sentences for a specific card version + language
get.description:
Returns all translation sentences for a specific CardVersion (by card external_id and version number)
in the given language. Each sentence includes field id and field name.
Returns all CardVersion rows for a card.
Returns all visible Encyclopedias (hidden ones are excluded). Optional ?q= search by name.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search in encyclopedia name

get.summary: Properties and lookup items of one card version by version external id (export)
get.description: Property values of one CardVersion addressed by its KMS id, each with the lookup items it references, plus the flattened distinct `lookup_items` list. Replaces KMS `card-property/external/list?CardVersionId=`.

parameters.name: lookup_tables
parameters.description: Comma-separated lookup table external ids; restricts lookup_items references to these tables.

get.summary: Raw sentences of one card version by version external id (export)
get.description: Phrase-level rows of one CardVersion addressed by its KMS id (the `cardVersionId` KMS uses). Replaces KMS `card-sentance/external/list?cardVersionId=`. Rows are ordered by field order, paragraph and item order. Hidden-field sentences are excluded unless `include_hidden=true`.

parameters.name: include_hidden
parameters.description: Include sentences of hidden fields (default false).

get.description:
Returns visible Card rows for a given Encyclopedia.external_id (404 if the encyclopedia is hidden; hidden cards are excluded).
Optional ?q= search by title.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search in card title

get.summary: Cards with their latest version, composed text and lookup items (export)
get.description:
The primary import endpoint. One paged call returns, for every card of the encyclopedia that has a qualifying version, its latest version (max version number, ties broken by version id) together with:
* `sentences`: one row per visible field - `text` is the field's phrases composed exactly the way Tamkeen Daeya composes the KMS `card-sentance` payload (phrases of a paragraph joined by a space, paragraphs joined by a newline, empty phrases/fields dropped, hidden fields skipped, rows ordered by `field_order`);
* `lookup_items`: the distinct lookup-table items referenced by the version's properties (optionally restricted with `lookup_tables`);
* optionally `properties` (raw per-field values), `phrases` (raw phrase rows) and `versions` (all stored versions of the card).

Cards without any qualifying version are excluded. Ordered by card external id; page through with `page`/`page_size`.

Incremental runs: pass the previous response's `next_cursor` as `updated_since`. The cursor is the time a card's latest version was first stored in Central-DB, so a new version is the only change it detects; sentence edits made to an existing version (rare, manual backfills) do not move it. `next_cursor` trails `generated_at` by a 10-minute safety window on purpose.

Coverage: Central-DB only holds what its KMS sync has ingested (approved versions; not every encyclopedia is populated). Check `/api/encyclopedias/{id}/sync-status/` before relying on an encyclopedia; an empty page means nothing ingested, not nothing published.

Replaces KMS `card/external/list-minimal` + per-version `card-sentance/external/list` + `card-property/external/list`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Cards per page (default 200, max 1000).

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: ISO-8601 datetime. Only cards whose latest version was first stored in Central-DB at/after this instant (CardVersion.created_at) are returned. Feed the previous response's `next_cursor` here for incremental runs. Naive values are UTC.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated sub-objects to embed per card. Options: sentences, phrases, lookup_items, properties, versions. Default: sentences,lookup_items. 'phrases' adds the raw phrase rows under each composed sentence row; pass an empty value (include=) for the minimal card+latest_version list.

parameters.name: lookup_tables
parameters.description: Comma-separated lookup table external ids; restricts lookup_items references to these tables.

parameters.name: cards
parameters.description: Comma-separated card external ids to restrict the listing to (debugging / targeted refresh).

parameters.name: approved_only
parameters.description: Pick the latest version among approved versions only (default true). Central-DB currently ingests approved versions only, so false changes nothing until unapproved versions are ingested.

get.description: Content fields of one encyclopedia (by KMS external id) with their display order and hidden flag. Replaces KMS `encyclopedia-field/external/list?encyclopediaId=`.

parameters.name: include_hidden
parameters.description: Include hidden fields (default true). Hidden fields never carry sentences.

get.description: Counts describing how much of an encyclopedia Central-DB currently holds (cards, versions, sentences, properties) next to the totals KMS reports, plus the time the newest version was stored. Lets a consumer detect stale or partial data before importing.

Returns all Languages (core.Language).
Optional ?q= search by any name or ISO code.
Optional ?export=csv or ?export=excel downloads the list as a file.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search by name, short name, native/English name, ISO code or ISO version.

parameters.name: export
parameters.description: Download the list as a file instead of JSON.

get.description:
Returns all LanguageTranslation rows (core.LanguageTranslation).
Optional ?language= source ISO code, ?target= target ISO code, ?q= search in the translated name.
Optional ?export=csv or ?export=excel downloads the list as a file.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Filter by source language ISO code (the language whose name is translated).

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Filter by target language ISO code (the language of the translation).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search in the translated name.

parameters.name: export
parameters.description: Download the list as a file instead of JSON.

get.description:
Returns the name of the given language (by ISO code) translated into all available target languages.
Optional ?target= returns only that target language.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Filter by target language ISO code.

get.description: All KMS lookup tables mirrored in Central-DB, with their item counts. Replaces KMS `lookup-table/external/list`. Optional ?ids= filter.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated lookup table external ids to return (default: all), e.g. 11,18,30,43,56,57.

get.description:
Items of one lookup table (by KMS external id), including the parent link that forms the item tree. Replaces KMS `lookup-table/external/items/{id}`.

Item external ids are unique only inside their table. `parent_external_id` is the parent's external id; `parent_lookup_table_external_id` tells which table it belongs to (normally the same table).

parameters.name: include_archived
parameters.description: Include items archived in KMS (default true, KMS parity).

get.description: Returns the nearest Arabic and translated phrase pairs for the provided query text. Search can be limited to one book using `project_id`, or run across all books. Each book uses its latest Arabic version with embeddings and a translation version in the requested language, then the latest translation revision for that version.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search text used to compute the embedding similarity.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Limit results to one book. Uses each book's latest Arabic version with embeddings and a translation version in the requested language.

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: Maximum number of examples to return. Defaults to 5.

200.description: Relevant phrase examples ordered by embedding similarity.

target_language.description: Arabic name of the target language.

404.description: Book or language was not found.
